requirements.requirement: Phase 2 exact accepted SHA passes Linux Windows macOS race and STRICT governance on work branch and main.
Device identity is persistent Ed25519 and concurrent first-start converges without overwrite or partial target visibility.
Pairing binds device/controller keys with expiring attempt-bounded one-use codes generations and revocation.
Paired device sessions require Ed25519 proof and shared registration bootstrap cannot mint or retain authority after pairing.
Controller sessions require paired Ed25519 proof and are invalidated by device generation or agent-session change.
Relay accepts only controller-signed CommandEnvelope payloads bound to current device and agent session and rejects nonce replay.
Privileged approvals are one-use short-lived and exact-request bound and cannot be self-asserted by remote request payload.
Audit primitive is structured secret-safe bounded and rejects symlink/free-form misuse.
